column1: # shell-guard behavioural cases. Space-separated leading tokens; command = rest:
# `ask` means AXIS 2 (guard-ask-escalation) resolves the arm to
# permissionDecision:"ask" JSON on stdout at exit 0 — run.sh asserts the exit
# code as 0 (same as plain allow) plus the JSON shape, not the literal token.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# --- BLOCK: recursive delete of a protected path ----------------------------
diskutil_erase   2 -    diskutil eraseDisk JHFS+ X disk2
# --- BLOCK: halt / fork bomb (still DENY-channel, AXIS 2 unchanged) --------
# --- BLOCK: eval fetching remote content stays DENY-channel (design.md D1) -
# --- ASK: privilege escalation / eval (no fetch) / chmod 777 / truncate ----
# (AXIS 2, guard-ask-escalation: reversible harm fully disclosed in the
#  command text — resolves to permissionDecision:"ask", exit 0, not exit 2)
# --- BLOCK: network download piped into an interpreter ----------------------
# --- BLOCK: through common non-evasive wrappers + compounds -----------------
# --- ALLOW: false-positive controls + dropped-arm regression locks ----------
# --- ALLOW: deliberately option-value-wrapped evasion is OUT OF SCOPE --------
# (plain `timeout 5 rm -rf /` IS blocked; the `-s KILL` glued-value form is the
#  evasion variant we deliberately do not chase — plan mode is the backstop)
# A leading SHELL_GUARD_EXTRA_PATTERNS=value is the guard's ENVIRONMENT (read
# via the env var, not the command text) — run.sh strips it and exports it for
# this case only. The pattern is a distinctive, space-free literal so the
# assertion can confirm the reason names THIS pattern, not a generic phrase.
# --- BLOCK: decision resolution (deny > ask > allow), regression lock for the
# 689327a ask()-exits-early bug — a deny anywhere in the compound command must
# win regardless of which arm the scanner reaches first. The first three rows
# are the exact verified-failing inputs from the regression report.
# deny-class first must still deny (already worked pre-fix, but the ask-side
# rewrite must not regress the ordinary case).
# Two ask-class arms, no deny anywhere: must still resolve to ask, naming the
# FIRST arm matched (sudo), not the second (chmod).
# An ask-class arm alone (no deny anywhere) must still ask post-refactor.
# --- BLOCK: eval/download exception — WHOLE-COMMAND scope, command-word/
# whole-word anchored, case-insensitive (regression + defect fixes 2-4). Each
# of these fetches (or names) curl/wget/fetch somewhere other than the eval's
# own stage/segment, which the pre-fix $seg-only check missed.
# Benign eval text merely containing the LETTERS of a download word inside a
# larger word must stay ask, not deny (unscoped substring match was defect 3).
eval_curling_benign   ask  -   eval "echo curling along nicely"
eval_wgettable_benign ask  -   eval "echo a wgettable resource"
